_visibility_comment: Declared OUTRIGHT, and this key is why this file is safe to add at all.
build_views.repo_is_public() reads an ABSENT precedent.json as private --
no config, not a Precedent repo -- but a PRESENT one with no 'visibility'
key as PUBLIC, on the reasoning that omitting the field is how a public
repo publishes private practice text by accident. This repo is private
and was relying on the absent-file path. Adding this file for the
timezone alone would therefore have flipped it to public and silently
dropped team- and individual-level practices from the tracked loader
block and the materialized tree. Verified before and after: repo_is_public
stays False and AGENTS.md regenerates byte-identically.
_commit_author_check_comment: into this repo (tools/checks/, practices/) on 2026-09-19, but
precedent-individual is deliberately NOT added to the `sources` list
above -- build_views refuses that outright: 'A shared repository may
only name sources everyone in it can read -- naming an individual set
here leaks its existence and location to the whole team'. Identity
still resolves correctly without it: bootstrap/commit-identity.sh's own
directly, a mechanism entirely separate from this file's `sources`,
which is only for practice TEXT reaching this repo's generated views.
Verified: the full-sweep run resolved 'Morgan F' <morgan@westegg.com>
and found the check's own violations correctly with no `sources` entry
_sources_comment: The universal catalogue, so a session rooted in THIS set can read it.
Until this landed a session here saw this set's own practices and
nothing else -- the generated occasion index below carries this repo's
own entries and not one of universal's, so every universal rule was
silently absent from every session ever run here while the session
applied the ones it could see. Upstream calls the fix 'shape 3' and
writes it up in spec/SOURCE_SET_PROSE_GAP.md.
NOTHING OF UNIVERSAL'S TEXT IS COMMITTED HERE, which is the whole
point and the reason this is not the shape that renders universal into
the tracked AGENTS.md block (that is 'shape 2', and it was rejected:
it commits a copy that then drifts). tools/precedent_session_practices.py
writes the resolved text to an UNTRACKED .precedent/SESSION_PRACTICES.md,
rebuilt each session, and .gitignore names that path so no `git add -A`
can ever offer it.
A RELATIVE SIBLING, not `~/BestPractice`. The path is resolved against
THIS repo -- precedent_source_bootstrap.py does (repo_path / path)
-- and $HOME is not where the sibling clones live: it is /root on this
container while this set sits under /home/user, so a ~ path names
nothing. The clone is created there by the --sources-from step in
.claude/settings.json, which takes the URL and the pinned branch from
tools/ENGINE_MANIFEST.json's own source_repo/source_branch. So this
needs no credential (BestPractice is public) and declares no new URL.
_fallback_timezone_comment: The zone for stamping commits and generated dates in THIS repo when
nobody's own zone resolves -- no PRECEDENT_COMMIT_TZ, no identity.json
reachable, no TZ in the environment. It is rung 5 of the ladder in
tools/precedent_time.py: a person's zone is person-level and lives in
their identity.json, while the answer for a person this project could
not identify is the repository's to choose.

New York, not Buenos Aires. This is a TEAM set: shared by level, and consumed by repositories with more than one member. Buenos Aires is Morgan's own zone and belongs in his individual source, not in a set an unidentified committer could be anyone in. Morgan, 2026-09-10: the Buenos Aires fallback is just for him personally; a shared set defaults to New York. Sibling declarations the same day: precedent-team-repo-maintenance, precedent-team-working-style, and the nomen-omen consuming repo.
APPLIED, NEVER ENFORCED, exactly as the engine-level rung below it is.
Applied, because the alternative is not 'no zone' but the container's
silent UTC, and a record stamped +0000 by somebody who is not in UTC
cannot be ordered against anyone else's. Never enforced, because
refusing somebody's commit over a zone THEY never declared blocks real
work on a value they never saw. Declaring a zone in your own
identity.json is what makes it yours and checked.
